_comment: Shard list for CI-tier-sweep's test job. This file is the SINGLE source of
truth: the job matrix is built from it via fromJson(), and SHARD_COUNT is
derived from its length by the `plan` job. Keeping the count in the matrix
by hand instead would allow the two to drift, and the harmful direction is
silent -- a SHARD_COUNT larger than the matrix drops groups that then never
Cost model (measured on the first real sweep): ~54 groups / ~800 test-runs
per tier at roughly 30s per integration test. Sequential that is ~7h per
tier. Each shard re-downloads the multi-GB handoff (a few minutes), so
sharding trades a few minutes of download for N-fold parallelism.
6 matches the self-hosted proxysql-ci pool size. Raise it only together with
runner capacity, and remember per-group INFRA_IDs keep Docker namespaces
